column1: # Taiwan / mainland vocabulary that names the same thing.
# The translation check (tests/cbdb_desktop/i18n.py) treats the two sides
# of each row as ONE word wherever it compares wording: 繁 against 简,
# a label against the glossary, and one form against another.  OpenCC's
# own Taiwan<->mainland phrase tables already cover the common computing
# terms (匯出/导出, 資料庫/数据库, 檔案/文件, 儲存/保存, 搜尋/搜索); this
# file is for pairs they do not know.  Maintained by hand, by the
# maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-22: a regional difference between the
# Traditional and Simplified pages is not a translation problem.
# One pair per line: Taiwan usage <TAB> mainland usage <TAB> note.
# Either script may be used in either column; both sides are compared
# after reducing to Simplified.  Lines starting with # are comments.

column3: link, connection (二階連結 / 二阶连接)
